message.content:
Below is a concise list of the **long‑weekend holidays that occurred in Canada during 2023**.  
(“Long weekend” means the holiday falls on a weekday that is adjacent to a weekend, giving you at least two consecutive days off.)

| # | Holiday | Date (2023) | Weekend Days Included | Notes |
|---|---------|-------------|-----------------------|-------|
| 1 | **New Year’s Day** | Sunday, Jan 1 | Saturday Dec 30 – Sunday Jan 1 | The holiday itself is on Sunday, so the weekend is Dec 30–Jan 1. |
| 2 | **Family Day** (Alberta, BC, Saskatchewan, Ontario) | Monday, Feb 20 | Saturday Feb 18 – Monday Feb 20 | (Louis Riel Day in Manitoba is on the same day.) |
| 3 | **Good Friday** | Friday, Apr 7 | Friday Apr 7 – Sunday Apr 9 | Good Friday is a statutory holiday. |
| 4 | **Victoria Day** | Monday, May 22 | Saturday May 20 – Monday May 22 | Celebrates Queen Victoria’s birthday. |
| 5 | **Canada Day** | Saturday, Jul 1 | Saturday Jul 1 – Sunday Jul 2 | The holiday falls on a Saturday. |
| 6 | **Labour Day** | Monday, Sep 4 | Saturday Sep 2 – Monday Sep 4 | First Monday in September. |
| 7 | **Thanksgiving** | Monday, Oct 9 | Saturday Oct 7 – Monday Oct 9 | Second Monday in October. |
| 8 | **Christmas Day** | Monday, Dec 25 | Saturday Dec 23 – Monday Dec 25 | The holiday falls on a Monday. |

### Quick Reference (by month)

| Month | Long‑Weekend Holiday(s) |
|-------|------------------------|
| Jan | New Year’s Day (Sat‑Sun) |
| Feb | Family Day (Sat‑Mon) |
| Apr | Good Friday (Fri‑Sun) |
| May | Victoria Day (Sat‑Mon) |
| Jul | Canada Day (Sat‑Sun) |
| Sep | Labour Day (Sat‑Mon) |
| Oct | Thanksgiving (Sat‑Mon) |
| Dec | Christmas Day (Sat‑Mon) |

> **Tip for your app** – If you need province‑specific holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, St. Jean‑Baptiste Day in Quebec, etc.), you’ll need to pull the appropriate provincial calendar. The table above covers the federal holidays that create long weekends across the country.

Feel free to let me know if you’d like the data in a particular format (JSON, CSV, etc.) or if you need province‑specific long weekends!
